projects.title: SeekOps Anemometer Design
projects.description:
-Designed a drone-mounted ultrasonic anemometer that accurately measures wind velocity without affecting drone performance.
-Accurately read wind readings to calculate methane emissions in dynamic wind patterns and/or complicated landscapes.
-Circuitry, CFD Modeling, Data Analytics, Data Visualization

projects.title: RESTful API
projects.description:
-Developed a RESTful API deployable onto multiple servers for retrieving rainfall data in Python
-Utilized Flask library to run server and return “application-type” JSON to URL endpoints
-Operated asynchronous HTTP requests by feeding work orders from HotQueue into Redis queue
-Improved client accessibility by composing a public Docker image
